interview.location: 美国加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺苹果公司总部
interview.occasion: CBS《60 Minutes》电视新闻杂志节目
interview.context: 2003年，乔布斯48岁。iPod已发布两年，iTunes Store刚上线。苹果正从纯硬件公司向服务和生态系统公司转型。乔布斯在CBS王牌新闻节目中罕见地谈及个人生活和对完美的追求。

key_segments.text_en: It's not just about the hardware. It's about the whole experience. The iPod is a combination of beautiful hardware, elegant software, and a seamless online store. And when you put all those things together, you get something that's greater than the sum of its parts.
key_segments.text_zh: 不仅仅是硬件的问题。而是整个体验。iPod是漂亮的硬件、优雅的软件和一个无缝的在线商店的结合。当你把所有这些东西放在一起时，你得到的东西大于各部分之和。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 系统思维 / 体验至上

key_segments.text_en: We're not just trying to make good products. We're trying to make the best products. And there's a big difference. Most companies are satisfied with making products that are good enough. We're not.
key_segments.text_zh: 我们不只是在试图制造好产品。我们是在试图制造最好的产品。这两者之间有很大的区别。大多数公司满足于制造'足够好'的产品。我们不。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 完美主义 / 极致追求

key_segments.text_en: We don't do focus groups. You know, it's not the consumers' job to know what they want. It's our job to figure out what they're going to want before they know it.
key_segments.text_zh: 我们不做焦点小组。你知道，知道消费者想要什么不是消费者的事情。我们的工作是在他们知道之前就弄清楚他们将会想要什么。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 用户洞察 / 直觉驱动

key_segments.text_en: I have a wonderful family. And they're the most important thing in my life. But I also love what I do. And I think the key is to find something that you love so much that it doesn't feel like work.
key_segments.text_zh: 我有一个美好的家庭。他们是我生命中最重要的事情。但我也热爱我所做的事情。我认为关键在于找到一件你如此热爱以至于不觉得是在工作的事情。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 热爱驱动 / 生活哲学

key_segments.text_en: Apple is a company that's built on values. We value creativity. We value innovation. We value design. We value simplicity. And we're not willing to compromise on those values.
key_segments.text_zh: 苹果是一家建立在价值观之上的公司。我们重视创造力。我们重视创新。我们重视设计。我们重视简约。我们不愿意在这些价值观上妥协。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 价值观驱动 / 文化建设

key_segments.text_en: The only way to avoid failure is to not try anything. And that's a much bigger failure than any specific thing you might fail at.
key_segments.text_zh: 避免失败的唯一方法就是什么都不尝试。那比你在任何具体事情上可能遭遇的失败都要大得多。
key_segments.thinking_pattern: 成长型思维 / 反恐惧

extractable_quotes: It's not just about the hardware. It's about the whole experience.
We don't just make products. We make experiences.
Most companies are satisfied with making products that are good enough. We're not. We want to make products that are the best in the world.
It's not the consumers' job to know what they want. It's our job to figure out what they're going to want before they know it.
Find something that you love so much that it doesn't feel like work.
The only way to avoid failure is to not try anything. And that's a much bigger failure than any specific thing you might fail at.
